Chapter 1 · The Resolution Paradox

The 2012 Climate Trap: The Artificial +404% Hotspot Surge

In 2012, NASA transitioned from 1,000m MODIS to 375m VIIRS. Because VIIRS has a 7.1x smaller pixel area, it catches small agricultural fires previously diluted below MODIS thresholds.

Chapter 2 · The Solution Architecture

Physics-Informed Architecture: 32 Geospatial Clues

Rather than treating satellite pixels as raw RGB imagery, SpectraLink models the entire physical transmission chain from burning Earth surface to orbital focal planes.

01
🛰️

Orbit & Sensor Geometry

Corrects pixel bow-tie enlargement and off-nadir distortion across orbital swaths.

A_pix(θ) = p₀ · sec²(θ)
  • Scan Angle (θ) Expansion
  • Solar Zenith Angle (θz)
  • Pixel Footprint Area (m²)
  • Local Satellite Elevation
02
📡

Atmospheric Physics

Quantifies optical depth, smoke transmission attenuation, and water vapor absorption.

τ_MIR = exp(-m · AOD₅₅₀)
  • Atmospheric Transmission (τ)
  • Total Column Water Vapor
  • Aerosol Optical Depth (AOD)
  • 4μm Radiant Transmission
03
🌿

Fuel & Biome Phenology

Extracts dynamic vegetative moisture and land cover taxonomy from Google Earth Engine.

NDWI = (ρ₈₆₀ - ρ₁₂₄₀)/(ρ₈₆₀ + ρ₁₂₄₀)
  • MODIS NDVI Vegetation Index
  • NDWI Moisture Deficit
  • Enhanced Vegetation Index (EVI)
  • MCD12Q1 Land Cover Taxonomy
04
☀️

Diurnal Progression

Synchronizes Terra morning (10:30 AM) with Aqua and VIIRS afternoon passes (1:30 PM).

I(t) = I_peak · exp(-(Δt)² / 2σ²)
  • Gaussian Diurnal Peak Kernel
  • Solar Radiant Heat Flux
  • Overpass Time Inter-Calibration
  • Day/Night Thermal Contrast
